$comment: Normative (FLR-ADR-006). The `default` keywords here are exactly the constant defaults of 1.8's Project table; the reference canonicalizer reads them as its table of constant defaults (9.2 step 1).
title: Project
description: 1.8: the one project a document describes. It is not an element: it carries no extensions, and only the members of its table.

name.title: Project name
name.description: 1.8: the project's name, 1–200 characters. Always present.

description.title: Project description
description.description: 1.8: free text, up to 2000 characters. Absent by default.
